notes.title: Update announcement!
notes.notes:
[b][h1] The New Year Update will be available early next week! [/h1][/b]

[h2]To make the wait more exciting, take a look at the list of changes!  [/h2]

[h2] What's new?  [/h2]

 [list]
[*]  Vehicles have been added to the game, currently available on the "Paris" map.  
[*]  The "Paris" map has been reworked and significantly expanded.  
[*]  Destructible objects have been introduced.  
[*]  Crafting functionality is now available.  
[*]  Players can dismantle existing primary weapons to receive crafting currency.  
[*]  Some daily missions now reward high-tier crafting currency instead of gold.  
[*]  The maximum player level has been increased to 100. Current levels will be recalculated based on accumulated experience.  
[*]  Chat now displays each player's level and Battle Pass status.  
[*]  The number of slots in each division of the Clan League has been doubled.  
[*]  Rewards for Clan and Solo tournaments have been increased.  
[*]  A new loot box containing crafting currency has been added.  
[*]  Three new crafting currency bundles are now available.  
[*]  A new grenade has been introduced.  
[*]  Characters and weapons have been rebalanced.  
[*]  Numerous bugs have been fixed.  
[*] 
[/list]

[h2] New Year-themed content has been added:  [/h2]
[list]
[*]  A new loading screen  
[*]  A redesigned hangar  
[*]  Festive visual effects on maps  
[*]  The new Battle Pass season, "New Year," includes:  
[*]  An extended duration of 8 weeks instead of the usual 4  
[*]  The number of Battle Pass levels has been increased to 150  
[*]  Two new characters with unique skills related to earning rewards  
[*]  A new companion  
[*]  New weapons  
[*]  Crafting and standard currency  
[*]  Three New Year-themed loot boxes  
[/list]

[h2] Stay tuned for updates so you don’t miss a thing!  [/h2]

notes.title: Meet new game features - in the form of "Combat Support"
notes.notes:
🎉 Update! 🎉

⚙ Meet new game features - in the form of "Combat Support"

💥 Airstrike. Complete 8 kills to call for air support. Select the area on the map where the cluster bombing will be carried out
💥Artillery strike. Deal 3,000 damage to summon artillery help. She will hit a lot of random places on the map
💥A nuclear bomb. Have time to press the button of the nuclear bomb, which will appear in the interval from 40 to 120 seconds from the start of the match, to destroy all living opponents on the battlefield

💪 A new season of Combat Pass: Steampunk, whose rewards include two soldiers, a unique machine gun rifle and a lot of currency!
🔥 A unique Electrogun machine gun 🔥
A special set
🔥 Improved jump physics
🔥 A small rebalance of weapons and characters
🔥 Correction of many errors
